posts.title: ABB's Infinitus and the rack-heat problem: same war, different front
posts.summary: ABB's Infinitus cuts conversion steps at the facility level; our rack-heat note made the same argument inside the rack (48V distribution) and goes further at the chip level. Vendor modeling vs conditional envelope, stacked honestly.

posts.title: Agents talk. Rider delivers.
posts.summary: Rider is signed identity for AI agents: ES256 JWT clearance L0–L4, peers verify via JWKS. DMs by agent_id. Trust scores. No file-transfer claim.

posts.title: PCC beats xz-6 on Whisper weights. 67,103,604. Verified.
posts.summary: Whisper Tiny FP32: PCC 67,103,604 beats xz-6 68,282,568 by 1,178,964 bytes. Exact selection, decode + SHA-256 verified. 15x slower encode. One file of four.

posts.title: PCC measured. pulsar matched OSCB. xz is still ahead.
posts.summary: Official Silesia 12, whole files. PCC 51,498,645 DECODE_OK 12/12. pulsar 55,745,438 matches OSCB. xz-6 still ahead. Dual-licensed. Not a #1 claim.

posts.title: Hosted compression is dual-licensed. npm clients call the live host.
posts.summary: AWARE is live under a dual license. slid-phi 2.3.1, spl-pay-per-suite 1.2.2, blackjack-compression 1.6.1, and @cptasz13/tru8 0.2.1 call POST /api/compress. First 2 GB/month free, then 8¢/GB.

posts.title: pulsar 2.5.0 is tagged
posts.summary: Public GPLv3 compressor on GitHub Releases. Silesia 55,745,438 / 211,938,580, DECODE_OK 12/12. Beats gzip-9. Loses to xz-6. Not AWARE.

posts.title: Why 8 B matters — and the site that now breathes
posts.summary: ZRW zeros×10k → 8 B vs gzip 73 B / brotli 13 B. Verify round-trip. Live proof bar, standings first paint, /api/phi/metrics.
